review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–121). It defines a private helper `abelClass`, a private naturality lemma, the natural transformation `abelMap`, and two lemmas about it. The Abel map from relative effective Cartier divisors to the relative Picard presheaf is a new construction, and I know of no Mathlib counterpart. The concepts it uses (`uliftFunctor`, `QuotientGroup.mk`, `forget CommGrpCat`, and the project's own `relativePicardPresheaf` and `relativeEffectiveCartierSubfunctor`) are reused rather than redefined. `abelClass` is private and is only the pointwise component of `abelMap`, so it is not a competing public API. I did not run searches of Mathlib for a rival definition, so the verdict rests on my reading of the file and my knowledge of Mathlib. I found no justified finding under this rubric.
